This facility is mapped as "Argo Data Center" in Dickens County, Texas, but no published power specification is available from an operator spec page. The name suggests a possible connection to Argo Blockchain, a publicly traded Bitcoin mining company known to operate large sites in Texas, but that link remains unconfirmed; research to match this location against the company's own disclosed facility list could not be completed.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 publish power figures totaling 468 MW. This facility does not appear in that published inventory, which means either it is not operational at publishing scale, or its operator has not disclosed capacity in a form this site has indexed.

Without a published megawatt figure, this location cannot be ranked among Texas facilities or assessed for relevance to AI scaling. The gap between mapped facilities and published figures in Texas is large, leaving open the possibility that substantial capacity exists here undisclosed.
